Ravi: Heads-up 1: NovaMetrics billed us twice for the Feb pilot + Mar renewal on invoice NM-2026-02. Link: https://novametrics.example/invoices/NM-2026-02
Priya: Can you paste the invoice summary + PO and contract id? cc @Marta (finance).
Ravi: Invoice lines:
``
Item: NovaMetrics Pilot Feb 2026 - $7,200
Item: NovaMetrics Annual Renewal Mar 2026 - $15,800
Tax: $0
Total: $23,000
PO: PO-115900
Contract: CT-2025-NM
``
billing-bot: Invoice NM-2026-02 uploaded to finance files: https://files.redwood/invoices/NM-2026-02.pdf :page_facing_up:
procurement-bot: Ticket created TKT-6288 "NovaMetrics double-billing + pricing model discussion" assigned to Priya. SLA 72h.
Priya: Proposed immediate asks: (1) pro-rata credit for pilot $7.2k OR a credit note applied to next invoice, (2) discuss switching to consolidated quarterly billing starting 2026-05-01, (3) run a pricing experiment: A) keep existing tiered per-usage pricing, B) pilot a flat monthly seat-like tier for our benchmarking windows. Need finance + legal input before we propose to vendor.
Marta: Finance prefers credit notes over refunds for small disputes. Quarterly cadence OK if cashflow impact is acceptable. For pricing experiment, we need forecasted spend and GL mapping. If the flat tier reduces near-term revenue recognition complexity, maybe worth testing for one quarter.
Ravi: I can attach benchmark logs (run-9090) showing Feb spike was scheduled testing. Will include a 12-week forecast for both pricing options.
VendorRep: Thanks for the details. We can issue a credit note for the pilot if you provide the run logs & PO. For pricing experiment: we can offer a 30-day flat-tier pilot at a trial price and measure delta vs tiered spend. Need written approval from finance + procurement to proceed.
Anya: Legal: approve receiving credit note in lieu of refund; we'll need a short amendment for cadence change and a data collection clause for the experiment. Send contract ref CT-2025-NM and I'll draft language.
Priya: Plan: (A) open dispute and request credit note >= $7,200; (B) offer vendor two experiment options and ask them to propose trial pricing for flat-tier pilot; (C) if vendor proposes a commit, procurement will evaluate against 3mo reserved commit and request a 5% committed-volume discount. Owners: @Priya (procurement), @Marta (finance), @Ravi (usage evidence). Target close Apr 18 to avoid month-end accounting churn.
Ravi: I'll upload logs + forecast to TKT-6288 and ping VendorRep. Thanks everyone. :pray:
